entries.title: Geometry: Basics of Geometry
entries.description: Lesson sheet for the Basics of Geometry unit, from line segments through diagrams, with a short algebra-review warm-up and the first parallel-lines skill at the high end. Easy to hard.

entries.title: Geometry: Angle Relationships
entries.description: One Basics of Geometry topic. Warm up on the previous angle leaves, practice angle relationships, then geometric diagrams. Easy to hard.

entries.title: Geometry: Basics and Parallel Lines
entries.description: Basics of Geometry plus the next unit, Parallel Lines and the Coordinate Plane, with an algebra-review warm-up and a first congruent-triangles stretch. Easy to hard.
entries.lesson: Basics of Geometry and Parallel Lines

entries.title: Geometry: Congruent Triangles Spiral
entries.description: Spiral review of Parallel Lines and the Coordinate Plane, then classifying triangles, with the first Properties of Triangles skill at the high end. Easy to hard.
